newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO Hoare Govett buys asset manager.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO Hoare Govett buys asset manager.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Monday it had acquired U.K. investment manager Carrington Pembroke and its unit trust subsidiary Pembroke Administration.
It said Carrington Pembroke currently managed some 335 million stg in private and institutional client funds.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed.

"This acquisition has enabled ABN AMRO to buy a retail fund manager with an established reputation and a strong track record. This will allow ABN AMRO Hoare Govett to make its first step towards offering a full fund management service in London," said ABN AMRO Managing Board member Rijnhard van Tets in a statement.

ABN AMRO said Carrington Pembroke's largest unit trust, the Pembroke Growth Fund, was currently the best performing U.K. equity growth unit trust over five years, seven years, and since its launch in December 1986.
It added the businesses would be renamed ABN AMRO Carrington Pembroke and ABN AMRO Pembroke.
